project.name: quick-chat
project.objective: Build a production-ready agentic RAG application with high accuracy and answer relevancy: replace the single-case-scoped flow with query rewriting, deterministic-first (LLM fallback) routing to Case, Financial and Procedural agents (structured + hybrid vector search with reranking, top 10 -> top 5), a supervisor that checks context relevance and retries agents up to a limit, grounded answer generation, full logging and LangSmith tracing per agent, and evals for every agent and component; must support cross-case questions such as all cases for a defendant or all REGISTERED cases for a hearing date.

plan_approval.reason: Approved the 10-task plan as shown (2026-10-17); start T01

approval.reason: Approved SPEC.md as written, including default answers to its open questions (2026-10-17)

assumptions.text: Hearing date for appearance-status questions means case_appearance.due_date; case_record.hearing_date is used only when no appearance filter is involved. REGISTERED is a CaseAppearanceStatus, not a CaseStatus.
SPEC.md supersedes PLAN.md S3/S4; PLAN.md S0-S2 work stays as built.

invariants.text: Tenant isolation, grounding (no fabricated case facts), retrieved content as untrusted data, and no case content in logs/traces remain binding for every agent and tool.

decisions.title: Agentic multi-agent flow replaces single-case scoping
decisions.text: Owner decision 2026-10-17: questions are not always case-scoped. Flow is rewrite -> deterministic routing with LLM fallback -> Case/Financial/Procedural agents -> supervisor relevance check with bounded retries -> grounded generation. Supersedes PLAN.md S3 resolve_case-first design and S4 agent split (Case Details/Procedural Hearings/Financial).

decisions.title: LLM provider: Claude via Anthropic
decisions.text: Rewrite, routing fallback, supervisor grading and answer generation use Claude via Anthropic (adds langchain-anthropic, approval given 2026-10-17 as a spec decision; install still confirmed at task time). Ollama stays a registered provider for local dev.

decisions.title: Hybrid search: Qdrant dense + sparse BM25 with RRF
decisions.text: Each agency collection holds a dense and a sparse BM25 vector; hybrid query fuses them with RRF in Qdrant, store-side filtered by tenant/case/source_type. Requires recreating every agency collection and re-ingesting.

decisions.title: Party-name matching: exact then fuzzy with candidates
decisions.text: Case-insensitive exact match first, then pg_trgm similarity; multiple plausible people are surfaced as candidates with case numbers, never silently picked.

decisions.title: Cross-case list cap 20
decisions.text: List answers return at most 20 cases plus the total match count and say explicitly when truncated.

decisions.title: Supervisor retries: 2 per agent
decisions.text: Supervisor may retry an agent at most 2 times with a rewritten sub-query when its context is judged irrelevant; then it answers with what is relevant or reports insufficient data.

decisions.title: Reranker: local cross-encoder in inference service
decisions.text: Hybrid top 10 reranked to top 5 by a sentence-transformers CrossEncoder served by quick_chat_inference /rerank; no new dependency; chunk text stays local.

decisions.title: Eval release gate
decisions.text: Isolation 100%, citation validity >=98%, faithfulness >=0.85, contextual precision >=0.7, answer relevancy >=0.8, routing accuracy >=95%, structured-tool exact match 100%.

decisions.title: Latency target p95 < 12 s non-streaming
decisions.text: End-to-end non-streaming p95 under 12 s on the dev dataset, per-node latency recorded.

knowledge.title: Current RAG graph is a linear placeholder
knowledge.text: core/rag/graph.py is understand -> resolve_case -> retrieve -> build_context -> generate -> finalize with stub nodes; resolve_case scopes every question to one requested case. No supervisor, agents, rewrite or rerank exist yet.

knowledge.title: Structured queries are case_id-scoped only
knowledge.text: get_payment_summary(session, case_id), get_appearances/get_next_appearance(session, case_id), get_cases_by_number. No party-name, case-status or hearing-date cross-case query exists; cross-case questions need new structured functions.

knowledge.title: Vector search is dense-only, no reranker
knowledge.text: Qdrant collection-per-agency holds dense vectors only (no sparse/BM25). Hybrid search needs a lexical index; adding sparse vectors to existing collections requires recreating them and re-ingesting. core/llm/reranking does not exist yet. 1149 points on southern_ute dev agency.

knowledge.title: LLM is local Ollama only today
knowledge.text: Generation registry has one provider (ollama, qwen3:4b per CHECKPOINT S1). PLAN D9 originally named Claude Sonnet default via Anthropic; the anthropic SDK is installed but langchain-anthropic is not.

knowledge.title: Domain map conflict for disposition/sanction
knowledge.text: SOURCE_TYPE_GROUPS puts disposition/sanction under outcome, SOURCE_TYPE_DOMAIN under financial. The new Procedural agent owns disposition, sanction (vector) and appearances (structured), which resolves this in favour of a procedural domain.

knowledge.title: Tracing and evals baseline
knowledge.text: traced_node fans out to structlog and a redacted LangSmith sink (ids/counts/latency only). evals/datasets is empty; deepeval is configured (.deepeval) but no golden set exists.
